result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now exists as a second name for the landscape command. The cli module's tests pass. I didn't run either command end to end, so I haven't confirmed that `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` produces `config.json` and `index.html`.

- **`Commands.java`**: I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description, which says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. The no-argument overview now lists `analyzeLandscape` before `updateLandscape`. The `updateLandscape` description now mentions `analyzeLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: Both names map to the same `updateLandscape` handler, so options and behaviour are identical. The handler checks which name was typed, so `-help` prints that command's own usage and description.
- **`README.md`**: It had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Commands" section covering `analyzeLandscape` (as the documented name), `updateLandscape` (older name, kept for existing scripts), `init`, `generateReports` and `updateConfig`.
